description: On the tabletop there’s a white paper cup on the right with a purple toothbrush inside, and a small toothpaste tube lying near the center. The right hand reaches to the cup, grips and lifts the toothbrush as a right-hand object, while the left hand moves in to pick up and open the toothpaste tube; the left hand then squeezes toothpaste from the tube onto the toothbrush bristles, after which the toothbrush is placed back into the cup and both hands release their objects.
